create_DataWriter: create a DataWriter instance to write trial data into an HDF5 file with a custom filename and directory
add_frame_temporal_data: add temporal data fields to the current trial using DataWriter add_frame with keyword arguments
add_img_frame: add image frame data to the current trial using DataWriter add_img_frame with keyword arguments
add_config_global: add global config data fields to the current trial using DataWriter add_config with keyword arguments
write_trial_hdf5: finalize and write the current trial data to the HDF5 file using DataWriter write_trial with an optional trial ID
